24 browser_* tools ship inside the app (built-in since v1.5.0, no plugin needed). Direct the Agent in chat to open pages, click, type or take screenshots. The Browser tab is a full browser that always works; with the floating-window permission, a transparent live overlay follows the Agent while you use other apps (tap the ball to toggle, long-press to end the session).
Open the full browser right here, or let the Agent browse — a transparent live-page window pops up automatically over other apps.
The Agent is browsing — tap to watch the live page full-screen on the browser tab, or use the floating ball overlay while in other apps.
Human takeover in progress — the browser tab is the full browser; Agent tools stay locked until you hand back.
The renderer is being rebuilt — the live view will resume automatically.
A full browser opens right here — address bar, tabs, find-in-page, downloads. No special permission needed. The Agent drives the same pages, so you can watch it browse live or take over anytime.
You are in control — Agent tools are locked

The browser tab above works without any permission. The floating ball, the live-page overlay and the full-screen takeover window are system floating windows — they need the "display over other apps" permission to appear while you use other apps.
